project_manifesto.title: Minimalist Architect Publication
project_manifesto.persona: Amir Mohammad Najafi (@njfamirm) - Software Architect & Tech Lead at Nexim.
project_manifesto.mission_statement: Signal over noise. Absolute digital minimalism. Form follows pure function.

theme.palette: Strict Monochrome. Pure Black (#000000) for Background (Dark), Pure White (#FFFFFF) for Background (Light). Use Zinc-Zinc for grays (Zinc-50 to Zinc-900).
theme.mode: System-preference-aware (prefers-color-scheme). Automatic switching between Light and Dark themes.

typography.primary: Inter for body text and long-form paragraphs.
typography.mono: Fira Code for ALL technical labels, dates, metadata, code blocks, navigation links, and most headings (h1, h2, etc.).
typography.STRICT_RULE: NO Persian fonts. No Vazirmatn. Use only Inter and Fira Code.

scrollbar.style: Minimal custom scrollbar (6px width). Monochrome Zinc-800/Zinc-200 thumb.
scrollbar.behavior: Hidden track, 3px rounded thumb that changes brightness on hover.

layers.description: 40px x 40px grid of subtle 1px lines (Zinc-200 in Light / Zinc-800 in Dark). 0.2 opacity.
layers.mask: Linear gradient fade at the bottom.

layers.description: 45-degree diagonal repeating linear gradient (0.5px foreground, 4px transparent). 0.03 opacity. Extremely subtle texture.

layout.system: Bento Grid implemented via strict CSS Grid with 1px explicit borders (gap-px).
layout.constraints: Max-width 1536px (2xl). Centered horizontally. Strict 0px border-radius (sharp edges).
layout.padding: Consistent p-6 to p-12 for distinct boxes. Paragraphs in blog content use max-width 2xl (max-w-2xl).

hover_logic.effect: Brightness Button Design (Hard Invert). On hover, background becomes foreground color, text becomes background color. Instant flip (duration-0, transition-none).
hover_logic.target: Interactive elements only: Navigation links, Identity links, Writing cards, CTA buttons.

interaction_system.selection: Selection color must be inverted: background=foreground, text=background.

content.statement: Shipping Value. Amir Mohammad Najafi (@njfamirm). Software Architect & Tech Lead at Nexim.

sections.content: [CONNECT] label followed by links: linkedin.com/in/njfamirm-me, github.com/njfamirm, medium.com/@njfamirm, njfamirm@gmail.com.
sections.style: Vertical list, font-mono, gap-0, each link takes full width.

sections.content: Recent Writing log. Lists top 5 articles with Title, Summary, Tags (#), and Date.
sections.style: Vertical list, divide-y, large padding (p-12), group-hover inversion.

blog_detail.meta: Date, Canonical URL (if exists), Tags with # prefix.
blog_detail.footer: Copyright year, name, and slogans: 'Building systems that matter.' and 'ARCHITECT → ENGINEER → HUMAN'.

strict_negative_constraints: FATAL ERROR if ANY 3D, WebGL, or Canvas elements are included.
FATAL ERROR if non-clickable blocks have hover effects.
FATAL ERROR if UI elements (except code blocks) use any colors other than Black, White, or Zinc-Grays.
FATAL ERROR if Persian fonts or RTL support is added.
FATAL ERROR if border-radius is more than 0px (except scrollbar thumb).
FATAL ERROR if transitions/animations are added to hover states (must be instant).
